description: Search an index. Wraps POST /{index}/_search. query is the query DSL only; sort, from, search_after, track_total_hits, highlight, script_fields and source (_source) map to the same-named body keys. size defaults to 10; with aggs and no query it is forced to 0. Page with from+size or sort+search_after. Use source to project fields and keep responses small. Returns {status, body}; a 4xx/5xx is an error with the ES root cause.

index.description: index, alias, comma list or wildcard, e.g. logs-*,metrics

search_after.description: sort values of the last hit

source.description: _source projection: list of fields or false

name: es_search
